ResearchProjectDef.label: tea cultivation
ResearchProjectDef.description: Grow tea herbs, dry their leaves on drying racks, and brew them into helpful beverages at a campfire or stove.

ResearchProjectDef.label: advanced tea cultivation
ResearchProjectDef.description: Cultivate finicky medicinal herbs and brew them into stronger teas with more pronounced effects. These herbs demand skilled growers and cooks.
